claims.text: IL-17 inhibitors (eg, secukinumab, ixekizumab) reduce inflam and joint Sx; they can be given alone or w nonbiologic therapy.
claims.quote: IL-17 inhibitors (eg, secukinumab, ixekizumab) are also effective in reducing inflammation and joint symptoms. Adverse effects include urticaria, upper respiratory infections, fungal infections due to Candida, diarrhea, herpes zoster, and worsening symptoms of inflammatory bowel disease. They can be administered as monotherapy or in combination with nonbiologic therapies.

claims.text: If a TNF inhibitor = ineffective, switching to an IL-17 inhibitor = preferred over switching to another TNF inhibitor.
claims.quote: For patients in whom a TNF inhibitor is ineffective, switching to an IL-17 inhibitor is preferred to switching to another TNF inhibitor.

claims.text: SE: urticaria, URIs, Candida infections, diarrhea, herpes zoster, and worsening IBD.
